title.rendered: VAN DYK Warehouse Tour and Order Fulfillment Process

content.rendered:
Take a video tour of our new North American Parts Distribution Center in Norwalk, CT. See a sampling of our vast parts inventory as well as a demo of our state-of-the-art order fulfillment process.

Take a video tour of VAN DYK Recycling Solutions’ new warehouse in Norwalk, CT. The warehouse holds over 13,000 different parts, stocked multiple times over for a total of $16.7 million in spare parts. The video shows a sampling of our vast parts inventory as well as a demo of our state-of-the-art order fulfillment process.
